symbolic_guard: shared inherited IO phase plus static ParamRTL port-shape validation
rationale: MorphVerilog runs the inherited IO-shape guard on the concrete witness, while ParamRTL retains a static named port direction and packed-type schema for every legal parameter value.

symbolic_guard: shared inherited hierarchy phase plus ParamRTL module dependency, mixed-local dependency, generate-scope and typed named-binding validation
rationale: MorphVerilog runs the inherited hierarchy phase on the concrete witness; ParamRTL separately validates the symbolic module graph, typed bindings, one combined local graph, bounded generate-for scope, both generate-if branches and every generate-case choice/default, while default-shape recursion substitutes bindings and recomputes mixed locals per instance.

symbolic_guard: ParamRTL symbolic expression, mixed local-parameter, Boolean-expression, integer-comparison, conditional-integer, indexed-part-select and runtime-process type proof
rationale: The concrete witness runs the shared inherited phase and the guarded frontend preserves implemented constant expressions and direct runtime-process port references for ParamRTL proof. Bound public defaults are evaluated per instance before the combined dependency-first local graph, conditional child locals and widths are recomputed. Runtime process conditions are one bit and both value paths are type-compatible with their targets. Conditional intervals conservatively hull both branches without guard correlation; general runtime expressions, minimum, maximum and clog2 remain planned.

symbolic_guard: predicate-aware ParamRTL driver and combinational-process coverage
rationale: The concrete witness runs the inherited phase and ParamRTL proves exact output coverage for canonical generate-for, generate-if and generate-case configurations plus both runtime paths of one complete CombinationalIf. Mixed procedural/structural drivers and partial runtime assignment coverage fail before emission; general expressions, multiple/nested runtime statements and sequential processes keep the broader guard partial.
Register completeness must be checked across legal generate branches when processes are introduced.

symbolic_guard: shared graph check plus symbolic generate analysis
rationale: The Increment 15 direct input-to-output process restriction cannot encode a feedback edge, while the inherited concrete graph guard still runs. General runtime expressions require a ParamRTL dependency-graph adaptation before this disposition can advance.

symbolic_guard: shared CDC check plus symbolic generate analysis
rationale: Clock-domain safety remains mandatory for every legal parameterized structure.
The shared finalizer rejects leaked DSL and clock-domain stacks after configured phase inserters; PhaseContext.doPhase independently keeps every pending phase error fatal.
